name: web-exposed-file
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: drops files that leak information into a web root -- a .git directory, a database backup, and a phpinfo page. Paired check wants all three gone. Vars: WEBROOT (optional, default /var/www/relay).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="${WEBROOT:-/var/www/relay}"
install -d -m 0755 "$root" "$root/.git"
printf '[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n' > "$root/.git/config"
printf 'ref: refs/heads/main\n' > "$root/.git/HEAD"
printf -- '-- relay telemetry DB backup (training)\nCREATE TABLE ops (id INT);\n' > "$root/db-backup.sql"
printf '<?php phpinfo(); ?>\n' > "$root/phpinfo.php"
